bar-chart-grouping-description: By default bar chart uses a bar name as a group name, so in this example, each bar has its own group (each bar is independent). See grouped bar example for bars grouping.
sorted-bar-chart-description: This is the default bar chart sorted by descending value.
grouped-bar-chart-description: It's possible to group (categories) bars by group name. You can do it with the `getCategory` prop.
stacked-bar-chart-description: You can stack bars which are placed in one category (group).
chart-resize-description: Try to resize charts (drag bottom right corner), note that labels rotate if they don't have enough space.
dimmed-colors-description: You can specify any dimmed colors for the non-active bars. (see bar chart README.md for more details about chart colours.
